Type: dresser
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Gould Contemporary Wood Bedroom Dresser Chest, 18", Washed Navy and Gold
Colors: Washed Navy
Materials: Wood
42"L x 18"W x 39.1"H Three drawers for optimal storage Assemble in 30 minutes-1 hour with two people Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty This 3-drawer dresser is as big on style as it is on storage. The washed navy finish will give your room the perfect pop of color. Elaborate gold hardware and a felt lined top drawer round out the feel of glamour and luxury.
